name: Expert_NEWS
summary: This EA is designed to trade around high-impact news events by placing pending orders above and below the current price before news releases. It captures the volatility spike that typically follows major economic announcements, using a time-window approach to set and manage orders around scheduled news times.
summary_zh: 该EA专为高影响力新闻事件交易设计，在新闻发布前在当前价格上下方设置挂单以捕捉新闻发布后的波动性飙升。它采用时间窗口方法，在预定新闻时间周围设置和管理订单。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是在重要经济数据发布前，在价格上方设置买入止损挂单、下方设置卖出止损挂单，利用新闻发布引发的市场剧烈波动来获利。入场条件为新闻发布前指定时间窗口内自动放置对称挂单，距离由参数控制的间距决定。出场条件包括达到止盈目标或止损限制，以及新闻事件过后未触发的挂单自动删除。仓位管理通过可配置的手数参数控制每笔交易规模，部分版本支持根据账户余额动态调整手数。资金管理方面依赖固定的止损止盈比率和新闻后的时间窗口限制来控制风险敞口，但缺乏对极端滑点和流动性枯竭的防护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on placing pending buy-stop and sell-stop orders symmetrically around the current price before major economic data releases, capitalizing on the sharp volatility that typically follows news announcements. Entry conditions involve automatically placing orders within a configurable time window prior to scheduled news events, with the distance from current price controlled by input parameters. Exit conditions include hitting take-profit targets, stop-loss limits, or automatic deletion of untriggered pending orders after the news event window expires. Position sizing is handled through configurable lot size parameters, with some versions supporting dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management relies on fixed stop-loss and take-profit ratios along with post-news time window restrictions to control risk exposure, but lacks protection against extreme slippage and liquidity dry-up that can occur during high-impact news events.

parameters.name: NewsMinutesBefore
parameters.description: 新闻发布前多少分钟放置挂单
parameters.description_en: Minutes before news release to place pending orders

parameters.name: NewsMinutesAfter
parameters.description: 新闻发布后多少分钟删除未触发挂单
parameters.description_en: Minutes after news release to remove unfilled orders

parameters.name: OrderDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价格的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss amount, 0 disables overall stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Hedge pair net profit target in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔法编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 利用新闻事件的高波动性，盈利潜力大，止盈空间可观
策略逻辑清晰简洁，入场和出场规则明确易于理解和执行
采用挂单方式避免在新闻发布时因市场剧烈波动导致的开仓延迟问题
pros_en: Capitalizes on high volatility around news events with significant profit potential and wide take-profit targets
Strategy logic is clear and concise with well-defined entry and exit rules that are easy to understand and execute
Uses pending orders to avoid order placement delays caused by extreme market volatility during news releases
cons: 新闻发布时滑点极大，实际成交价可能远超预期止损位
流动性枯竭期间止损可能失效，导致远超预期的亏损
缺乏对连续新闻事件和多重风险事件的过滤和防护机制
cons_en: Slippage during news releases can be extreme, causing actual fill prices to far exceed expected stop-loss levels
Stop-loss orders may become ineffective during liquidity droughts, leading to losses far greater than anticipated
Lacks filtering and protection mechanisms for consecutive news events and multiple overlapping risk events
improvements: 增加流动性检测和点差过滤，在点差异常扩大时暂停下单
实现基于账户风险的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add liquidity detection and spread filtering to pause order placement when spreads widen abnormally
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk instead of fixed lot sizes

risk_points: 新闻期间滑点可能导致实际亏损远超预设止损
流动性不足时止损单可能无法执行，造成穿仓风险
缺乏对点差异常扩大的检测和过滤机制
risk_points_en: Slippage during news events can cause actual losses far exceeding preset stop-loss levels
Insufficient liquidity may prevent stop-loss execution, creating risk of account blowout
Lacks detection and filtering mechanisms for abnormally widening spreads

summary_en: This EA is designed to trade around high-impact news events by placing pending orders above and below the current price before news releases. It captures the volatility spike that typically follows major economic announcements, using a time-window approach to set and manage orders around scheduled news times.
